# ToastController

> Creates and manages toast notifications via the global toast manager.

## Constructor

```ts
new ToastController(host: HTMLElement)
```

## Methods

| Method | Parameters | Returns |
|--------|------------|---------|
| `toast()` | `options: ToastOptions` | `number` |
| `dismissToast()` | `id: number` | `void` |
| `dismissAllToasts()` | `—` | `void` |
| `destroy()` | `—` | `void` |

## Usage

```ts
import { ToastController } from '@nonoun/native-ui';
const ctrl = new ToastController(element);
// In teardown: ctrl.destroy();
```
